title: Document Rust unsafe invariants
why: Unsafe blocks transfer memory, aliasing, and lifetime obligations from the compiler to maintainers.
suggestion: Add an attached SAFETY comment that states the invariants making the block sound.
limitations: The rule verifies that a nonempty SAFETY rationale, with or without a colon or uppercase spelling, is attached; it does not prove soundness.
A rationale may precede up to six lines of local `let` setup or attributes used by the unsafe expression.
Macro-generated unsafe blocks are not visible in source text.
